mapper.select: SELECT k.id AS id, k.indicator_id AS indicatorId, i.name AS indicatorName, i.aliases AS aliases, k.field AS field, k.text AS text, k.source_id AS sourceId, s.title AS sourceTitle, k.locator AS locator FROM indicator_knowledge k JOIN knowledge_source s ON s.id = k.source_id LEFT JOIN exam_indicator i ON i.id = k.indicator_id WHERE k.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY k.indicator_id IS NULL, k.id
